_about: Rules SafeMigrate uses to raise risk signals. They are signals for the worker to double-check, not legal findings. Each rule cites its source.

free_visa_free_ticket.note: Employer should pay visa and air ticket; agency service charge capped at NPR 10,000. Widely violated in practice, so a higher demand is a warning sign, not proof of fraud.

visit_visa.note: Nepal does not allow travelling on a visit/tourist visa for work. Workers who do get no labour permit, no welfare-fund cover and no legal support under Nepal's foreign employment law.

labour_permit.note: Every worker needs a labour permit (Shram Swikriti) from the Department of Foreign Employment before leaving, issued through a licensed agency or individually.

scam_compound_sectors.note: 'Customer service', 'data entry', 'typing' and 'iGaming/casino' jobs, especially in Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos or on Gulf visit visas, are a known route for trafficking into online scam centres.
